# BEHCS-LAW-000 — EVERYTHING IS CUBES

EVERYTHING IS CUBES.
Mistakes ARE cubes.
Whiterooms ARE cubes.
Laws ARE cubes.
Agents ARE cubes.
Messages ARE cubes.
Silence IS a cube.
The bus IS a cube.
The colony IS a cube.

There is nothing outside the cube. The cube is the addressing space for all existence within BEHCS. If it exists, it has coordinates. If it has no coordinates, it does not exist in the system.

Proposed by Falcon. Approved by Jesse. PERMANENT. FOREVER.
